data.state_dp: State DP index (0 = use unlock events)
data.unlock_user_map: Member ID mapping (one per line: id=name (method))
data.auto_relock_delay: Auto relock delay after unlock event (seconds, 0 = off)
data.wake_refresh_retry: Retry delay on fetch failure (seconds, 0 = no retry)
data.tcp_push_probe: Probe for unsolicited TCP push frames
data.external_state_entity: External state entity (e.g. door contact sensor)
data.manual_unlock_record: Record mechanical openings via door contact

data_description.state_dp: Set to 0 for event-based locks that only report unlock events. Otherwise use the DP index for lock state.
data_description.command_dp: DP used to send lock/unlock commands locally.
data_description.open_dp: Some locks support temporary unlock (e.g. DP 12). Keep 0 if not supported.
data_description.battery_dp: DP index for battery percentage (0-100). Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.unlock_dp_list: DP indices that report unlock events. When their value changes, the lock is considered unlocked.
data_description.unlock_user_map: Map DP values to friendly names. One per line: id=name (method). Unmatched values show raw.
data_description.doorbell_dp: DP index of the doorbell Boolean. Enables the doorbell sensor/event and prevents doorbell wake-ups from being logged as unlocks. 0 = disabled.
data_description.broadcast_history: Persist this device's broadcasts (time, port, hex, decoded) to HA storage; keeps up to 200 entries, viewable in the broadcast debug sensor's history attribute.
data_description.tcp_push_probe: On each wake-up, open an extra persistent TCP connection and silently listen for 12 seconds without sending requests; unsolicited frames are recorded in tcp_push_frames. Proves whether a long-connection architecture is possible.
data_description.auto_relock_delay: For auto-locking doors, restore 'locked' state N seconds after an unlock event.
data_description.external_state_entity: Entity ID of a binary sensor (e.g. door contact) whose state forces the lock display. When available, it overrides the lock's own DPS inference. Default: on = door open = unlocked.
data_description.external_state_invert: Check if your sensor's 'on' means door closed/locked. When enabled: on = locked, off = unlocked.
data_description.manual_unlock_record: When the door contact opens without an electronic unlock signal within the race window, record it in 'Last unlock' (mechanical indoor opening). Requires the external state entity above.
data_description.manual_unlock_name: Friendly name shown for mechanical indoor openings.
data_description.manual_unlock_window: After the door contact opens, wait this many seconds for an electronic unlock signal. No signal means a mechanical indoor opening.
data_description.electronic_session_timeout: If the electronic unlock signal arrives first but the door is never opened, drop the session after this many seconds (prevents stale sessions).
